note: Actor orientation, decoded from the ROM and confirmed against the trig table itself.
routine: 0x01FFA6F8, called from the actor render path 0x020104D0 with r0=actor+0x8C, r1=actor+0xC8, gated by the dirty byte at actor+0xD0.

representation.actor+0xC8: three u16 DS binary angles - X at +0x00, Y at +0x02, Z at +0x04. A full turn is 65536.
representation.sin_cos_table: 0x020F88C4. 4096 entries of 4 bytes: a s16 sine then a s16 cosine, both 20.12 fixed point.
representation.index: angle >> 4, so the table covers the full 65536-unit circle at 4096 steps.
representation.evidence: 0x01FFA6F8 does ldrh from [r1], [r1,#2] and [r1,#4], asr #4 on each, doubles it twice to index the table, and reads with ldrsh - then smull to combine. Sampled entries match sin and cos to four decimal places.

fast_path: If X and Z are both zero the routine takes a shortcut at 0x01FFA738 using only the Y angle - the common case of an actor that only yaws.
port_usage: Convert a DS binary angle to radians with angle * TAU / 65536. Entity yaw values in arena_entity_placements.json were derived from the matrices this routine builds.
